reviews.title: So many ads!
reviews.text:
The game is unplayable because there are so many ads. 
It’s really sad too because it could be a fun game if there weren’t so many ads. 
Stop being greedy with the ads and you may just attract a lot more players.
So many of these apps turn out to be massive failures because the creators are just looking for a massive pay out from all the ads.
If you would lessen the ads, you would attract so many more players.

- disappointed

reviews.title: Way to many ads!
reviews.text: Wayyyyyy too many ads. You already watch a lot of ads to help you advance, open chests, spin the wheel, etc. but you will be towards the end of your 10 question match and they literally stop it to throw an ad in it. EVERYTIME! Why not wait till the end of the match! It drives me crazy. This whole game is just crazy with ads. They want $7.99 a WEEK for ad free. Most games ask for a one time fee for ad free which I always pay when I like a game but 7.99 a week is insane. No thanks. Otherwise I really like this game but will be deleting it because the ads drive me nuts.

reviews.title: Promising Game!
reviews.text: Long story short, the game is really fun if you’re a movie fan. However, the repetitiveness of many questions/movies could cause boredom. I had “Sherlock Holmes” for an answer for at least 10 times now. Also the answer choices are repeated A LOT they don’t seem random. If I don’t know the movie I just look for the unfamiliar answer and pick it, which isn’t really fun/challenging. Also the pictures sometimes have the name of the movie on them. One last thing, it’s not shown what the max levels are, what the cash is for after opening the three theaters, and how the difficulty system works.  It’s a great promising game, but it needs a lot of improvement. 👍🏼
